title: M1: The engine follows a beat clock: start on the bar, tempo changes, stop
description:
## Purpose
The `Mixer` in `crates/apricity-engine/src/mixer.rs` runs on its own frame counter today. Teach it to **follow a beat clock** from outside: which beat it is at a given output frame, the tempo, whether the clock plays, and the quantum (beats per bar). Source-agnostic and pure: no Link SDK here, so the same code runs in `apricity play` and, as wasm, in the AudioWorklet. Tests drive a scripted clock.

## Scope
- `apricity-engine::clock`: a clock line (beat at frame, tempo, playing, quantum), beat/frame math, next bar line.
- Following in the `Mixer`: bar 1 starts on the clock's next bar line; stop with the 5 ms fade; edits swap at the clock's next bar line; seek picks the score bar that starts at the next bar line.
- Tempo changes: the following strategy decided in M0 (planned: a varispeed bridge until the arrangement re-warped at the new tempo lands at the next bar line), plus a drift trim and a resync on clock jumps.
- Re-warp at the clock's tempo through `Renderer` (a timeline tempo override), reusing cached renders when a tempo comes back.
- A wasm export in `crates/apricity-web/src/lib.rs` so the worklet can pass clock lines.

## Out of scope
The Link peer (M2), the browser clock transport (M3), any language change: a score keeps one `tempo`, and positions stay in score beats.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  C[clock line: beat@frame, tempo, playing, quantum] --> M[Mixer: position from beats]
  C --> F[control side: tempo watcher]
  F -->|tempo settled| R[Renderer.arrange at clock tempo]
  R -->|Arrangement| M
  M -->|until swap: varispeed bridge| O[audio out]
```

## Definition of Done
1. `features/link/clock.feature` is green through the cucumber runner `crates/apricity-engine/tests/clock.rs`; no red specs; 100% coverage of the new code.
2. Rust only. No Python parity needed: analysis and the manifest are untouched.
3. No schema change (nothing stored changes).
4. No CLI yet (M2).
5. Fixtures: a click-track manifest and score under `crates/apricity-engine/tests/fixtures/clock/`; the WAV is generated by the test (no audio in git).
6. `design/link.md` gains an "Engine" section.
7. `docs/concepts.md` "From score to sound" says the mixer can follow an outside clock.
8. Web: none in this epic (the wasm export is consumed in M3).
9. Verify: `export PATH=$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH && CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 RUST_TEST_THREADS=2 safe-run.sh -- cargo test -p apricity-engine` and `node web/test/wasm.test.mjs`. The allocation guard in `tests/realtime.rs` covers following mode.
10. Running log on every task.
11. Release: `feat(<task id>)` per task; not breaking (the free-running mode is unchanged).
12. Depends on M0. Blocks M2 and M3. Relates apricitus-8edd5f (unwraps in the mixer) and apricitus-205813 (wasm FFI hardening).
